registryEntry.label: NSG Boundary Protection Rules
registryEntry.get_command: Get-AzNetworkSecurityGroup -ResourceGroupName '{resourceGroup}' | ForEach-Object { $nsg = $_; [PSCustomObject]@{ NSGName = $nsg.Name; SecurityRules = $nsg.SecurityRules | Select-Object Name,Protocol,SourceAddressPrefix,DestinationAddressPrefix,DestinationPortRange,Access,Priority,Direction; DefaultSecurityRules = $nsg.DefaultSecurityRules | Select-Object Name,Access,Priority,Direction } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
